gloss: to one's heart's content; as much as one likes

definitions.gloss: to one's heart's content; as much as one likes; to the fullest
definitions.explanation: Doing something freely and fully, without holding back or worrying about limits. Used when someone can do as they please without restraint.

examples.japanese: {思|おも}う{存分|ぞんぶん}⟦{楽|たの}しんで→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{思|おも}う{存分|ぞんぶん}⟦{寝|ね}たい→寝る：00470_neru⟧。
examples.english: On my day off, I want to sleep as much as I like.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{思|おも}う{存分|ぞんぶん}⟦{走|はし}り{回|まわ}った→走り回る：04608_hashirimawaru⟧。
examples.english: The children ran around to their hearts' content in the spacious park.

notes:
An adverbial expression meaning to do something without restraint or holding back. Composed of ⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧ (to think/desire) + ⟦{存分|ぞんぶん}→存分：12228_zonbun⟧ (to one's satisfaction). The nuance is that one can fully indulge without worrying about consequences or limits.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {思|おも}う{存分|ぞんぶん}⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧: to enjoy to the fullest
- {思|おも}う{存分|ぞんぶん}⟦{遊|あそ}ぶ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧: to play as much as one likes
- {思|おも}う{存分|ぞんぶん}⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: to eat to one's heart's content
- {思|おも}う{存分|ぞんぶん}⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発揮|はっき}する→発揮する：17267_hakkisuru⟧: to demonstrate one's ability to the fullest

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{存分|ぞんぶん}→存分：12228_zonbun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: similar meaning but slightly more formal
- ⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧な⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧: as much as one likes — more casual and conversational
- {心|こころ}ゆく⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: to one's heart's content — more literary and elegant
